project_context.archetype: Archetype 4 (Swiss & High-Contrast) with Cinematic Dark Mode nuances
project_context.core_vibe: Minimalist, high-end, precise, objective, dark gallery aesthetic

scale.h1: text-5xl sm:text-6xl md:text-7xl tracking-tighter font-medium leading-[1.1]

rules: DO NOT USE INTER FOR HEADINGS.
Headings must use Outfit with tight tracking.
Use Space Mono for section numbers (e.g., '(01)', '(02)') and small technical data.
Ensure contrast ratios are met. Light grey text on #0a0a0a.

grid_patterns.asymmetric_two_col: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-12 gap-12 md:gap-24 items-start (col-span-4 vs col-span-8)

spacing_and_layout.alignment: Prioritize left alignment for content. Use asymmetrical layouts to create tension.

visual_enhancers.borders: Use 1px solid border-white/10 for cards and structural separators.
visual_enhancers.textures: Add a subtle grain overlay (opacity 0.03 - 0.05) over the entire screen to remove digital flatness.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-black/60 border border-white/10 (for sticky headers only).
visual_enhancers.icons: Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide. Emphasize Plus (+) icons for decoration and Arrow-Up-Right for external/action links.

components.navigation: Sticky top, crystal glassmorphism, minimal layout. Logo left, links center, CTA right.
components.hero: Massive typography split across lines. Include animated stats (Projects Completed, Experience, etc.) using mono font.
components.cards: Flat dark cards (bg-secondary or transparent), 1px border-white/10, square or subtly rounded (max rounded-lg). Hover state: border brightens to white/30.
components.marquee: Use react-fast-marquee. Outline text (text-transparent stroke-white) for dynamic background texture.
components.buttons: Brutalist or elegant pill. Background white, text black for primary; or border-white/20 with hover:bg-white hover:text-black. Incorporate magnetic hover effect if possible.
components.accordion: For FAQ. Minimalist. 1px bottom border per item. Plus icon that rotates to 'X' on open.

animations.scrolling: Lenis smooth scroll is MANDATORY for premium feel.
animations.reveals: Framer Motion. Fade in and slide up (y: 40 -> 0) with blur on scroll.
animations.micro_interactions: Hover states on cards (slight lift, border glow), arrow rotation on link hover.

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Wipe the current bright white/blue color scheme. Set root body background to #0a0a0a and text to #ffffff.
2. Keep the ASSK Studio content (services, contact, FAQ) but present it in the dark, minimalist chkstepan.com style.
3. Use #0047FF strictly as a high-contrast accent (e.g., hover states, small badges, or underline accents) against the dark theme.
4. Add '(01)', '(02)', etc., in monospace to all major section headers.
5. Implement Lenis for smooth scrolling in the main layout wrapper.
6. Convert all cards to have transparent or #171717 backgrounds with subtle 1px white/10 borders.
7. Include `data-testid` on all interactive elements for testing.
